source: existing generated NPC society in pirates.game/pirates.society
method: World.new_generated(seed, {history_days: 365}) with society news intercepted before its 120-row display cap
nontrivial_event_day_definition: all society news except npc_market_event and port_arrival
limitations: The historical 365-day/302-event log cited by the spec is not present in the repository.
This is a reproducible one-seed capture of the current old-game NPC layer, not that missing historical log.
The old layer retains only the newest 120 society news rows and 80 legacy fleet strings; the capture intercepted society news before truncation.
Repeated alliance news rows do not prove duplicate active treaties; the old system ended with one expired agreement record.
The current old-game system has evolved beyond several original findings, so findings are not assumed to reproduce identically.
